abilities.name: Siege Mode
abilities.text: Activate to enter Siege Mode. While in Siege Mode, Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage, have 100% increased range, and deal 25% of their damage as splash damage around the target.

abilities.name: Spider Mines
abilities.text:
Create 3 mines that arm after 1.25 seconds. Mines detonate when an enemy comes in range, dealing 96 damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds.

Siege Mode: Cast range increased by 100%.

abilities.name: Concussive Blast
abilities.text:
Deal 141 damage to enemies in front of Sgt. Hammer and knock them back.

Siege Mode: Radius increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Neosteel Plating
abilities.text:
Gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

Siege Mode: Grants 100% more Armor.

abilities.name: Napalm Strike
abilities.text: Deals 164 damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Blunt Force Gun
abilities.text: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500 damage to enemies in its path. Deals 50% damage to Structures.

1.name: Ambush
1.text:
Gain Stealth when entering Siege Mode or after not taking or dealing damage for 3 seconds while in Siege Mode. Basic Attacks while Stealthed deal 125% more damage.

Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

1.name: Advanced Artillery
1.text: Increase Siege Mode's splash damage to 60% of Basic Attack damage, and increase its splash radius by 25%.

1.name: Maelstrom Rounds
1.text:
Activate to increase Basic Attack damage dealt by 40% for 5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode reduces the cooldown of Maelstrom Rounds by 5 seconds.

Stores up to 3 charges.

4.name: Barricade
4.text: Reduce Concussive Blast's cooldown by 4 seconds, its Mana cost by 40, and when cast create an impassable wall in front of Sgt. Hammer for 4 seconds.

4.name: Siege Tactics
4.text: Using Neosteel Plating while in Siege Mode grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds, as long as she remains in Siege Mode.

4.name: Regenerative Bio-Steel
4.text: Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

7.name: Pulse Detonation Core
7.text: Spider Mines detonate 3 times over 3 seconds. All damage from Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Spider Mines by 1.5 seconds. Increase this bonus to 2.5 seconds while in Siege Mode.

7.name: Hover Siege Mode
7.text: Sgt. Hammer can move at 50% Movement Speed while in Siege Mode.

7.name: Graduating Range
7.text: While in Siege Mode, Basic Attack range is increased by 1 every 1.5 seconds, up to 3.

10.name: Blunt Force Gun
10.text: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500 damage to enemies in its path. Deals 50% damage to Structures.

10.name: Napalm Strike
10.text: Deals 164 damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

13.name: Tactical Mine Deployment
13.text: Moving while Thrusters is active leaves a trail of up to 5 Spider Mines. Additionally, increase the Slow of Spider Mines by 15%.

13.name: Entrenched
13.text: While in Siege Mode, Concussive Blasts's damage and knockback distance are increased by 75%.

13.name: Hyper-Cooling Engines
13.text: While in Siege Mode, hitting Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Thrusters by 5 seconds.

16.name: Mechanical Know-how
16.text: Neosteel Plating grants 20% maximum Health as a Shield for 2 seconds and increases Basic Attack damage by 30% for 5 seconds.

16.name: Executioner
16.text: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

16.name: Giant Killer
16.text: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

20.name: Orbital BFG
20.text: Blunt Force Gun's missile orbits the planet every 5 seconds. Only the last missile fired orbits.

20.name: Advanced Lava Strike
20.text: Increase the cast range of Napalm Strike by 75%, and its impact deals 65% more damage.

20.name: Shrapnel Mines
20.text: Upon detonating, Spider Mines reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 10, up to 50, for 4 seconds.

20.name: Ultra Capacitors
20.text: Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode grants 10% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, up to 60%.
